annotations.title: Get what a scene has on air

description: Reads what the scene has on air: each stream the scene is set on, with online (whether that stream is on air now) and, while it is, the frame on air, the frame cued next, the controls' values, each source's status and what its playlists play. Empty when no stream has the scene.
name: scene_get_live_state
title: Get what a scene has on air
